red_tape.note: A 2020 parliamentary committee report records the Museum's account that a delayed response from the Minister's Office to its board nominee submissions left it without a functioning Board of Trustees in 2015 and 2016, and that a submission made after board terms lapsed in December 2019 was not attended to until new appointments took effect on 2 April 2020.

basis: Governance: the About page says the Museum is a statutory body governed by the Fiji Museum Act, and the committee report section 2.0 and 2.1.3 names the line ministry; red tape: the committee report section 2.1.3 on the non functioning Board of Trustees.

basis: Governance: the Act on the Finnish National Gallery 889/2013 (consolidated to the 2022 amendment), sections 1 and 2 on the legal form and the museums that belong to it, the section on the board's tasks for the budget, the section on openness of activity, and the transitional section on staff employment contracts; Kiasma has no legal form of its own, so the form is that of the Gallery it belongs to.
